name: TourRoutingPlanner
tagline: Route tours, rank holds and settle shows in one Power Apps control
description: A complete tour-booking app for booking agencies, artist managers and promoters: per-artist routing map with drive limits, days off and radius-clause checks, hold ranks with automatic release of competing holds, tour calendar, shows list and guarantee-vs-percentage settlements.
features: Routing map with leg distances, drive time and fly legs
Drive limit, days-off and radius-clause checks
1st/2nd hold ranks, hold challenges and automatic release on confirm
Drag-and-drop holds board with live rule checks and Undo
Settlement sheet: guarantee vs %, plus %, door deals, fees and commission
Demo mode, phone layout, keyboard and screen-reader support
